Description:
The
SchM_Result
is used to collect the result of
an asynchronous call of a
BswModuleEntry
in-
voked by
SchM_Call_<bsnp>[_<vi>_<ai>]_name(
<data_1>...<data_n>)
.
Using
SchM_Result
it is possible get back the result of call.
The
SchM_Result
API includes zero or more IN/OUT and OUT pa-
rameters to pass back results.
The pointers to all parameters passed by reference must remain valid
until the API call returns.
If the
SchM_Result
crosses partition borders, the callback is
mapped to
IOCSend_<id>()
.
Return Value:
The return value is used to indicate errors from either the
SchM_-
Result
call itself or communication errors detected before the API
call was made.
